facts.title: tomato and fried provolone sandwich
ingredients: 4 1/2-inch thick slices your favorite sturdy bread
4 tablespoons mayonnaise, or more to taste
Flaky salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 to 2 slices of provolone, pre-sliced is fine, per piece of bread (see Note at end)
facts.author: Deb Perelman
